notes: Dashboard/template configs, activate rules and the three order DataTable field/filter updates are copied from iba-demo feature/demo_1021 at cdaa3b6; the BI UMD is from the same commit, which adds configurable helmetViewUrl on top of createBiRuntime runtime keys and updateComponentMeta. Their mock-only reason/action/scope calls remain replaced by the cockpit ai-tables API, which reads AP facts and merges only evidence-linked structured card fields. The BI UMD keeps the local null-instance guard. The cockpit supplies only the delivered single-query adapter and does not inject the batch adapter. Host adaptation: the composite filter keeps the default period YWLN_D044=2025-10 because the page scope and published cards are bound to that period, and runtime export rewrites the upstream absolute helmetViewUrl to /api/gateway2/x360/v1/graphs/helmet-view.

knownIssues.description: Upstream child definition is absent; runtime reports the gap and keeps the original position empty.
